messages.text:
Hey Guys,

Can this unit ship to Australia and come with an Australian power supply or
is this unit still just rolling out in the States ?

Kind regards,
Cody

Hi Cody,

Yes, we ship to Australia, and it's not US-only. Australian orders go out from our US warehouse, so the delivery side is sorted.

The plug is the one caveat. Our miners are built with a built-in power supply and an IEC inlet, and the cord option on the listing is US, UK or EU matched to your address, so there isn't an Australian lead in the box. In practice that's a cheap fix: any standard IEC C13 kettle lead with an AU plug works, they're a few dollars at any electronics shop here, or you can run the supplied cord through a travel adapter.

One thing I'd rather confirm than guess: tell me which unit you were looking at and I'll check the exact input voltage range on that model for 230V, plus the current ship date. The Magic Miner 40T, for example, is rated 100 to 240V so it's fine on Australian mains.

Happy to get a cart ready for you once you've picked.

Kind regards,
Sarah H.
